title: Heavenly Secrets Converge as One
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped into the ultimate hall of the cosmic will, the existence beyond time and space finally revealed Its true face—a face Chen Ji knew all too well.

text.content: The Void trembled, and the Turtle Shell artifact beneath Chen Ji's feet dissolved into streaming light that merged into his body, resonating thunderously with the Jade Pendant left by Chen Tianming in his chest. An unprecedented power surged from every limb and pore, washing through all his meridians, completely repairing the hidden wounds left from gazing into heavenly secrets. The fragments of the Tianji Record flew from his Brow Center, golden light blazing intensely as they transformed into an ancient simple longsword, with heavenly secret runes flowing across its blade, as if recording all the secrets of eternity.

dialogue.content: Foolish pawn... You think merging a few broken items can compete with the Heavenly Dao? Throughout the ages, all who dared to gaze directly upon me have turned to ashes!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting countless stars moving in their trajectories. Those were futures he had once foreseen—all possibilities within three hours, now spread out before him, as clear as lines on a palm. However, this time, he was no longer a beggar passively窥视 fate, but a chess player holding the board. "Eyes of Heaven?" He laughed lightly, the laughter carrying ten thousand years of suppression and endurance, "No, now I should call you by your true name—Fate Writer."

dialogue.content: I remember. Thirty-seven thousand two hundred and nineteen times I gazed into heavenly secrets, thirty-seven thousand two hundred and nineteen times you erased the future. Thirty-seven thousand two hundred and nineteen times, I struggled at the edge of death while you laughed coldly behind the chessboard. Today, the account is settled.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record was fully awakened, and the Voice of the Fate Writer rang out in Chen Ji's mind: A choice lay before him, which would determine in what manner he would face the final battle.

choices.description: Accept the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, face the judgment of the Heavenly Dao will in complete form, and obtain power surpassing the Three Realms.
choices.visible_reward: Combat Power breaking through the celestial limit, Tianji Sword complete form awakened
choices.risk_hint: Power fluctuations may alert more enemies

text.content: The runes of the Tianji Record frantically poured into Chen Ji's body, each fusion accompanied by tearing agony, yet also by a surge of power. Golden light pierced through nine layers of clouds, illuminating the entire battlefield of the Three Realm Allied Forces. Countless people looked up at the sky, faces full of shock.

choices.description: Break through with the limit of existing power, retain some hidden abilities of the Tianji Record, preserve trump cards for the final battle.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the hidden skill 「Fate Writing」, can temporarily rewrite causality in battle
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a bitter battle when confronting the Heavenly Dao will

text.content: Chen Ji chose the more steady path. The power within his body was like a compressed volcano, seeking a breakthrough at its limits. A dark golden light erupted from his entire body—that was power surpassing ordinary heavenly secrets—the original ability of the Fate Writer.

choices.description: Without waiting for complete power fusion, directly challenge the Heavenly Dao will, complete transformation through battle.
choices.visible_reward: Gain fragmentary knowledge of the Heavenly Dao will in battle, glimpse the truth of the eternal chess game

text.content: Chen Ji had no hesitation, the Tianji Sword swept across the sky, its sword energy tearing the Void, pointing directly at the existence sleeping at the end of time. "Come." He only said one word, his voice calm, yet carrying undoubtable majesty.

dialogue.content: What?! You... How do you know that name?! That is a secret I sealed at the dawn of creation!

text.content: In the Void, a massive eye slowly opened, its pupil reflecting the birth and death cycles of countless realms. That was the Eyes of Heaven—or rather, the本体 projection of the Fate Writer. Its威压 was like mountains toppling, the entire Three Realms trembling beneath this power. Yet Chen Ji stood firmly in place, even a hint of mocking smile at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: I know far more than you imagine. For instance—your true body is not in this universe. For instance, every hundred thousand years you need to devour the soul of a Heavenly Fate bearer to sustain your existence. For instance... you fear me.

text.content: The Tianji Sword hummed in Chen Ji's hand, the runes on its blade transforming into golden flowing light, weaving a massive net of fate in the Void. Chen Ji reached out, gently touching the center of that net—where there was an invisible thread connecting to a distant and ancient spacetime. "Thirty-seven thousand years ago, you chose my father Chen Tianming." He slowly said, "But you didn't expect him to leave me behind."

A crisp voice sounded from behind Chen Ji. Chen Nian had somehow broken free from the light cocoon binding her, her eyes washed clean by tears now shimmering with unprecedented determination. The same aura of the Tianji Record pulsed from her body, resonating with Chen Ji from afar. "Heavenly Fate Lock Key?" The voice of the Eyes of Heaven carried emotional fluctuation for the first time, "Impossible! I clearly already..."

dialogue.content: You clearly already erased all her memories? Yes, you did. But you forgot one thing—the inheritance of the Tianji Record never relied on memory.

text.content: Chen Ji and Chen Nian reached out simultaneously, two golden lights meeting in the air, transforming into a冲天 pillar of light. The power contained within that pillar made the pupil of the Eyes of Heaven contract sharply—it was power surpassing fate itself, the primordial force that existed before the eternal chess game even began. Turtle Shell artifact, Chen Tianming's relics, Tianji Record fragments—three supreme treasures merged completely at this moment, transforming into a fully crystalline Jade Ruler.

choice.prompt: Heavenly Secrets Converge as One, three treasures become one to form 「Fate Jade Ruler」, Chen Ji is about to complete his final transformation. At this moment, he faces the final choice.

choices.description: Let the Heavenly Dao will witness what a true chess player is, the eternal chess game ends today!
choices.visible_reward: Reputation greatly increased, morale of Three Realm Allied Forces soaring
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao will may make desperate moves

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, the Fate Jade Ruler held horizontally before him, his entire being exuding an air of dominating the world. The Three Realm Allied Forces cried out in unison, their voices shattering一片片星辰. "From this day forth," his voice resounded across the universe, "I, Chen Ji, am the sole chess player of this eternal game!"

choices.text: Calm Layout, Strike After the Enemy
choices.description: Not rushing to directly confront the Heavenly Dao will, first see through all of Its底牌 before making a move.
choices.visible_cost: Give the enemy a chance to recover
choices.visible_reward: Gain more intelligence on the Heavenly Dao will, unlock hidden plot clues
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity for battle

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to strike. He closed his eyes, the power of the Tianji Record推演 countless possibilities within his mind. When he opened his eyes again, a knowing smile appeared at the corner of his lips. "So that's how it is, your true body is upstream in the River of Time. No wonder you never act personally—for that would require a price you cannot bear."

choices.description: Regardless of what the Heavenly Dao will does, sister's safety is the top priority. Siblings join hands to face the ultimate battle together.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian affinity greatly increased, unlock hidden bond 「Twin Heavenly Fate」
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao will may use Chen Nian as leverage

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, placing Chen Nian behind him. In that moment, he was no longer a calculating chess player, only an older brother protecting his sister. "Niannian, don't be afraid." He said softly, his voice carrying unprecedented tenderness, "As long as I'm here, no one can take you away."

dialogue.content: Enough! Do you think these things can shake me? When I existed, your so-called Three Realms were merely a speck of dust!

text.content: The Eyes of Heaven erupted with world-destroying might, countless strands of causal lines shooting toward Chen Ji from the Void. Each of those lines represented a fate manipulated by It—the fall of countless geniuses, the覆灭 of countless civilizations, countless不甘 souls howling in time. However, facing all this, Chen Ji merely gently raised the Fate Jade Ruler in his hand.

dialogue.content: The eternal chess game ends today.

text.content: The Jade Ruler lightly swept, all the approaching causal lines shattered completely. The Eyes of Heaven let out an unbelievable roar, fear reflecting in Its pupil for the first time. Meanwhile, an old yet familiar voice rang in Chen Ji's mind—that was the voice of the Fate Writer, also the voice of the true master of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: From now on, you are no longer a piece, but a chess player. Go, my inheritor. Overturn this eternal chessboard, rewrite this unjust Heavenly Dao!

text.content: The Tianji Sword completely transformed, becoming a golden-white divine sword, the ancient characters 「Heavenly Secrets Converge as One」 on its blade shining brilliantly. Chen Ji held this sword, feeling unprecedented power flowing within his body. That was power surpassing fate—the power to write fate. He could sever causality, rewrite life and death, turn the impossible into possible. And the price was that his bonds with this universe would grow increasingly faint, until turning to nothingness. But so what? He had waited for this day for thirty-seven thousand years. The Three Realm Allied Forces lined up behind Chen Ji, their banners遮天蔽日, their fighting spirit piercing the clouds. The projection of the Eyes of Heaven twisted continuously in the Void, Its power being gradually dismantled by the Fate Jade Ruler. "No... This is impossible..." Its voice carried madness, "I schemed for eternity, how could I lose to an ant like you!" Chen Ji stepped upward through the void, each step shattering a layer of Void barriers. "Your mistake was treating my father as a discarded piece." His voice was cold as the deepest abyss, "You thought you erased his traces, but you never expected him to leave this world's greatest enemy behind." The Heavenly Secrets Converge as One Sword was raised high, its tip gathering enough energy to destroy an entire realm. "This sword strike is for all souls you manipulated since ancient times." Chen Ji said calmly, then slashed down. Where the sword light passed, the projection of the Eyes of Heaven shattered with a thunderous crash, countless causal lines dissolving into scattered light across the sky. The Three Realm Allied Forces erupted in earth-shaking cheers, yet Chen Ji merely quietly gazed into the depths of the Void—where another pair of eyes was watching him through a crack in time.
